tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List every account in the Book of Business with its raw CRM-style metadata (id, vertical, lifecycle stage, ARR, docks, health, sentiment, tier, owners, tagged champion). No analysis applied — health/sentiment fields are exactly what's in the source record, including any that contradict other evidence.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get full metadata for one account by id, plus the list of source documents available for it (without their content — use list_account_documents or get_account_document to read them).

tools.name: list_account_documents
tools.description: List the source documents (profile, transcripts, renewal tables, tickets, notes, emails) available for a given account, with their file names and types.

tools.name: get_account_document
tools.description: Fetch the full raw content (markdown) of one specific document for an account. Use list_account_documents first to get valid file names.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Crude substring search across every document in the Book of Business (case-insensitive). Not semantic search — returns raw matching lines with surrounding context. Useful for finding where a keyword, name, or figure appears across the whole portfolio.

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Monthly flight-hour and mission-count history for one account, where available (accounts that are actively flying — not every account has usage history, e.g. pre-sale prospects). Returns an empty array if there's none. This is a live series — like everything else here, poll it rather than caching it once.

tools.name: se_list_dataset_files
tools.description: List the files in the SE track's customer-data corpus (accounts, issues, feature requests, tasks, meeting notes) — for the Knowledge Base and Product Feedback Lifecycle problem statements. Unrelated to the CS Book of Business tools above. Also available as a single zip download from the Problem Statements page.

tools.name: se_get_dataset_file
tools.description: Fetch the full raw markdown content of one file from the SE dataset. Use se_list_dataset_files first for valid file names. Files are large (the issues and meeting-notes files run to several thousand lines) — this returns the whole thing, not a page of it.

tools.name: se_search_dataset
tools.description: Crude substring search across every file in the SE dataset (case-insensitive). Not semantic search — returns raw matching lines with surrounding context.
